description: Luminate Year-End 2025 — US genre breakdown of ondemand audio streams. Top 5: R&B/Hip-Hop 25.5 % (−0.8 pp), Rock 15.3 % (flat), Pop 12.6 % (+0.3), Latin 8.0 % (+0.6 pp = largest gainer), Christian/Gospel 3.5 % (+0.4). Latin's US-share gain coheres with the IFPI LATAM +17.1 % regional narrative.
source: Luminate Year-End 2025 Music Industry Report; MBW coverage.
licence: Luminate published figures; MBW press coverage.
notes: US-only. Non-US genre breakdowns are publicly cited only for headline 'most-local' shares (separate table).
